entry.author: ACC New Zealand
entry.summary:
Are you an experienced clinical psychologist or psychiatrist who is keen to add some variety to your work, flexibility in your schedule and the chance to help people during a critical time in their lives? If so, then we’d love to hear from you at ACC.

Learn more about working with ACC as a mental injury assessor and apply:
https://www.acc.co.nz/for-providers/provider-contracts-and-services/mental-injury/mental-injury-assessments

SUBSCRIBE for more ACC New Zealand stories ▶ https://www.youtube.com/c/accnz/

If you're injured in an accident in New Zealand, whether it's relatively minor or something more serious, we're here to give you care and support so you can get back to everyday life. 

We help with prevention, care and recovery: https://www.acc.co.nz/about-us/
